propositions: Multiple redundant policy frozensets and explicit command selection ladders were removed; the router now derives all authority sets from a single _registry.derive_policy_sets() source.
Every command/intercept route now carries exactly one runtime-used parser factory, init policy, and lazy handler, dispatching through a unified _execute.execute path.
Generated CLI help and reference artifacts pass byte-identical --check validation on second render, confirming no behavioral delta in argv/diagnostics/output/exit codes after compat exports removal.
Module sizes remain within bounds (_cli/__init__.py 340 LOC, _registry.py 754 LOC); no mechanically-split file created below 100 lines; complexity ratchet shows improvements.

Whole-route shadow comparison and per-family E2E subprocess tests confirm identical behavior across all command families in reconcile/review-plan/enrich/config/verify/identity/audit after retirement of duplicate authorities.
